DevOps utilities

Usage:
  erun devops [command]

Available Commands:
  container   Container utilities
  k8s         Kubernetes utilities

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for devops

Global Flags:
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.

Use "erun devops [command] --help" for more information about a command.
